changes.description: Replaced angular/fire with plain firebase, as the angular/fire library doesn't seem to be well maintained, and the library it relies on (rxfire) doesn't seem maintained at all.

Fixed a bug where logging out from the user page caused the page to break. This happened due to the user page attempting to access the user's data - which was already deleted post logout. Now, once logout is complete, the user page redirects the users back to the home page instead.
